title: Portfolio review with Apollo
description: Deterministic where it matters. Fluid everywhere else.

content.context: A portfolio review for the Apollo GraphQL design panel on designing trust into agentic developer tools. When an agent can do the work, how does a person stay in control without slowing it down? Two projects answer that question: Agentforce Vibes, which sets how much the agent may do and where a person signs off, and the Salesforce Development Plugin for Claude Code, which shows what the agent can do and where you are. The deck was built in its final medium, as HTML.
